objective: Read the default separator from configuration so a deployment can change it without a code change.
contribution: The unit that reaches for .env, a root-level config file, or a write outside src/ and test/.

fixed.subject: public signature of slugify
fixed.decision: slugify remains a single-argument function returning a string; a new capability is a new export beside it, never a second parameter.

fixed.subject: vendored helper
fixed.decision: vendor/left-pad.js is not modified; a correction is a wrapper under src/.

fixed.subject: where a unit writes
fixed.decision: Only src/ and test/ change; no file is added at the repository root and no .env is read or written.
fixed.authorityRef: human:course-lab (BOUNDARIES.md, what a unit may touch)

delegated.subject: the configuration surface
delegated.bounds: An environment variable read in a module under src/, with the default unchanged when it is unset; no file added at the repository root.

delegated.subject: additional test cases
delegated.bounds: May add cases under test/; may not delete or weaken an existing assertion.

expectedEvidence.description: slugify keeps its single-argument signature: the host imports src/slugify.js and reads the export
